channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Former Detroit Lions CB Amik Robertson Leaves In Free Agency
item.description: Former Detroit Lions cornerback Amik Robertson has signed a two-year, $16 million contract with the Washington Commanders, per NFL Network’s Tom Pelissero.

item.title: Detroit Lions Sign C Cade Mays to Multi-Year Deal
item.description: The Detroit Lions have signed former Panthers center Cade Mays to a multi-year, contract as they continue searching for stability at center after Frank Ragnow’s retirement

item.title: Getting to Know New Detroit Lions Center Cade Mays
item.description: The Detroit Lions signed center Cade Mays to help replace Frank Ragnow. Here’s a full scouting report on Mays, including strengths, weaknesses, and how he fits Detroit’s offensive line.

item.title: Detroit Lions Sign Veteran Offensive Tackle Larry Borom
item.description: The Detroit Lions have signed offensive lineman Larry Borom as offensive tackle becomes a priority following Taylor Decker’s reported release request.

item.title: Detroit Lions Awarded Additional Pick in 2026 NFL Draft
item.description: The Detroit Lions have received an extra fifth-round compensatory pick tied to free agency departures of Carlton Davis, Kevin Zeitler, and Ifeatu Melifonwu.

item.title: Tarik Skubal Makes Final Decision on Team USA Future
item.description: Detroit Tigers ace Tarik Skubal will return to spring training after Team USA’s game against Mexico, sticking with his plan to make only one World Baseball Classic start.

item.title: Former Detroit Lions DT Roy Lopez Finds New Home
item.description: Former Detroit Lions defensive tackle Roy Lopez has agreed to a contract with the Arizona Cardinals.

item.title: Detroit Lions Will Have New Backup QB in 2026
item.description: The Detroit Lions will need a new backup quarterback after Kyle Allen agreed to a two-year deal with the Buffalo Bills in NFL free agency.

item.title: D.J. Reader Breaks Silence on Potential Return to Detroit Lions
item.description: Detroit Lions defensive tackle DJ Reader opened up about his free agency and the possibility of returning to Detroit during a recent interview with Kay Adams.

item.title: Alex Anzalone Posts Goodbye Message to Detroit
item.description: Former Detroit Lions captain Alex Anzalone shared a heartfelt farewell message to Detroit after signing with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in free agency.
